title: [Bug]: Async retrieval paths call sync `postprocess_nodes()` instead of `apostprocess_nodes()`
author: gautamvarmadatla

comments.author: dosubot[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- Answer -->
Thanks for the detailed bug report! I can confirm this issue and it's actually more widespread than initially identified.

**Confirmed affected files in your list:**
- [chat_engine/context.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/chat_engine/context.py#L148-L156)
- [chat_engine/condense_plus_context.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/chat_engine/condense_plus_context.py#L215-L223)
- [query_engine/citation_query_engine.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/query_engine/citation_query_engine.py#L244-L250)
- [query_engine/multi_modal.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/query_engine/multi_modal.py#L106-L108)
- [tools/retriever_tool.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/tools/retriever_tool.py#L101-L123)

Note: The multi-modal chat engine files (`multi_modal_context.py` and `multi_modal_condense_plus_context.py`) don't appear to exist in the current codebase.

**Additional affected files I found:**
- [RetrieverQueryEngine.aretrieve()](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/query_engine/retriever_query_engine.py#L140-L142) - the base query engine itself has this bug
- [evaluation/retrieval/evaluator.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/evaluation/retrieval/evaluator.py#L35-L50) - `RetrieverEvaluator` and `MultiModalRetrieverEvaluator`
- [objects/base.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/objects/base.py#L76-L88) - `ObjectRetriever.aretrieve()`
- [networks/network/retriever.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-networks/llama_index/networks/network/retriever.py#L43-L55) - `NetworkRetriever._aretrieve()`

Also in integrations: `VectaraQueryEngine` and `KodaRetriever`.

**Note on RetrieverQueryEngine:** Contrary to the issue description, the `_async_apply_node_postprocessors` method doesn't actually exist in the codebase - `RetrieverQueryEngine` itself has the same bug, calling sync `_apply_node_postprocessors()` in its async path.

The fix for all locations would be to await [`apostprocess_nodes()`](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/postprocessor/types.py#L65-L86) instead of calling `postprocess_nodes()`:

```python
# Before (incorrect)
nodes = postprocessor.postprocess_nodes(nodes, query_bundle=query_bundle)

# After (correct)
nodes = await postprocessor.apostprocess_nodes(nodes, query_bundle=query_bundle)
```
